title: Say hello from your bench
prompt:
Your first real program. Open `hello.py` in VS Code and add one line that prints `Hello from Gadget Gulch!` exactly.

Run it two ways. In the terminal, type `python3 hello.py`. In VS Code, press the Run Python File button, which runs the same command for you [py-024]. Then run the tests.
hints: The line starts with `print(` and ends with `)`.
Text goes inside quotes: `print("...")`, with the words between the quotes.
The whole line is `print("Hello from Gadget Gulch!")`. Save the file before you run it.
explain_after: `python3 hello.py` handed your file to the interpreter, which ran it straight from the source file with no separate build step [py-031]. The tests read the same file and checked what it printed.
